Name: primary vaccine failure
Description: The risk of primary vaccine failure estimated by the model in the reference scenario without waning.

Name: infection rate
Description: Parameter drawn from model fits to determine the rate of infection.

Name: duration of maternal immunity
Description: Parameter drawn from model fits for the duration of passive immunity in newborns.

Name: parameters for seasonality of transmission
Description: Parameters drawn from model fits to account for seasonality in transmission.

Name: importation
Description: Parameter drawn from model fits for the importation of cases.

Name: report rate of imported cases
Description: Parameter drawn from model fits for the reporting rate of imported cases.

Name: vaccine effectiveness
Description: Parameter drawn from model fits for vaccine effectiveness, related to primary vaccine failure.

Name: existing immunity in older generations
Description: Parameter drawn from model fits for pre-existing immunity in older age groups.

Name: parameters of spatial spread
Description: Parameters drawn from model fits to govern the spatial spread of measles.
